findings.title: Docs and init promise credential-free local dev, but secrets CLI/API and LockContext still require CS_* env vars
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Cited code confirmed: the next-steps lost the CS_* instruction, the README claims no credentials are needed, and the secrets CLI, the Secrets constructor and loadWorkSpaceId still require CS_* or TOML. The skill file still documents CS_*.

findings.title: Native @cipherstash/auth loaded eagerly breaks every stash command on platforms without a prebuilt binary
findings.label: valid
findings.note: stash.ts statically imports the auth module, and login.ts loads the native @cipherstash/auth at module top level. The lockfile lists only six platform binaries, so platforms without one plausibly break every command.

findings.title: Mandatory interactive device-code auth makes `stash init` unusable non-interactively or offline
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The confirmed unconditional interactive auth step, with no skip flag and a process.exit on bind failure, blocks non-interactive and offline init.

findings.title: Exact-pin downgrades of @byteslice/result and evlog change library runtime for all consumers
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The lockfile diff confirms the downgrades (byteslice 0.2.2 to 0.2.0, evlog 1.11.0 to 1.9.0) and the exact pins. This is a plausible consumer-facing runtime change introduced by the PR, though its impact is unproven.
